messages:
devon: Quick check — weights for sage-mini-v2 are in gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v2/2026-03-18/weights.pt. Tokenizer files landed next to it (vocab.json, merges.txt, special_tokens.json). Noticed odd behavior with chat templates where outputs sometimes start with duplicate BOS tokens. ping @maya for token mapping sanity.

maya: Seeing the files, thanks. I pulled `special_tokens.json` and it lists `bos_token: '<s>'`, `eos_token: '</s>'`, `pad_token: '<pad>'`. Can you paste the chat template you're using?

devon: Template is short: `"<s>{role_prefix}{user}

{assistant}</s>"` — we intended runtime to add BOS only when absent. On hosted smoke tests some responses begin `'<s><s>Hi...'` or `'<s>
<s>Hi'` (weird).

maya: Hmm. Two possible sources: (1) loader preprends BOS by default, (2) model tokenizer used at serving time treats `<s>` as just another token and isn't normalized.

simon: Repro steps I ran:
```
# emulate serving tokenization
python -c "from tokenizer import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer('gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v2'); print(t.encode('<s>Hello'))"
```
Output included two leading tokens in the id list.

anya: Quick config check: model.yaml has `add_bos: true` and serve_config.json has `strip_bos_if_template_has_it: false`. That combo can produce duplicates. Suggest change: set `strip_bos_if_template_has_it: true` or flip `add_bos` to false and rely on templates.

devon: Good catch. I can open a tiny PR to flip `strip_bos_if_template_has_it` to true and add a unit that asserts `encode(template) startswith bos xor add_bos`. Will that cover ZWJ/zero-width joiner issues? We saw a case with zero-width space before `<s>` that tricked the check.

maya: Add a normalization step: `tokenizer.normalize_whitespace_and_zwj(text)` before template checks. Also special_tokens.json should include alternate sentinel aliases, e.g., `"bos_aliases": ["<s>", "\u200B<s>"]` so we can map them.

simon: I'll add a tiny test in `tests/tokenizer_normalize_test.py` to cover `"\u200B<s>Hello"` -> single BOS.

devon: PR #4523 opened: flip flag + normalizer + test. @simon can you review?

simon: Looking now. Two nits: add one-line comment on why we accept ZWJ in aliases, and update `docs/tokenizer.md` to note the `strip_bos_if_template_has_it` semantics. Otherwise LGTM. :+1:

maya: Also validate weight path checksum in the PR CI: `sha256: 3f8a...` (already computed). Add a smoke `python -m serve.emulator --model-path gs://... --tokenizer-path ...` run to ensure runtime parity.

oncall-bot: deploy-check: CI passed for PR #4523 -> all checks green. Rolling canary on staging in 10m. :robot_face:

anya: Post-deploy, I'll run the chat-template regression suite. If we still see duplicates, we should add a runtime dedupe pass that collapses consecutive BOS tokens at decode time.

devon: Thanks team — will merge after simon comments. I'll note the follow-ups in the PR about dedupe pass and docs. :pray:
